units.source_text: 推了一会儿之后，轨道的坡度逐渐变得平缓起来。

en.t: After they had pushed for a while, the slope of the track gradually became gentler.

units.source_text: “已经不用再推了。”——他们会不会很快说这句话呢？

en.t: Would they soon say, "We do not need to push anymore"?

units.source_text: 可是那两个年轻的工人还是默默地继续推着矿车，只是微微把腰挺直了一些。

en.t: But the two young workers still kept pushing the mine cart in silence, only straightening their backs a little.

units.source_text: 良平终于忍不住胆怯的问：“接着往上推车吗？”

en.t: At last Ryohei could not hold back and asked timidly, "Are we going to keep pushing the cart uphill?"
